name: lemma
description: Source-linked JSONL chunks from Solidity compiler inputs and Markdown documents.

interface.shortDescription: Source-linked JSONL chunks from Solidity compiler inputs and Markdown documents.
interface.longDescription: Runs one of two standard-library Python chunkers: Solidity from solc standard JSON input, or Markdown from a document tree. The output uses a shared schema that separates source text used for quotation from model and embedding text. Lemma does not embed, index, retrieve, or answer from the chunks.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $lemma to turn Solidity or Markdown sources into validated JSONL chunks.
